_comment_1: DealSense Smart Setup seed catalog. Every URL here is ingested through backend/services/ingestion_service.py, which scrapes the real listing and records a real PriceObservation. Nothing in this file sets a price -- prices come from the merchant.
_comment_2: To grow a setup: open the product on Amazon.in or Flipkart.com, copy the address bar URL, and append an entry below. Then run: python -m scripts.tracker --seed-setups
_comment_3: Only Amazon and Flipkart are in scope. Entries for other merchants are skipped by the ingester with status UNSUPPORTED_MERCHANT.
_comment_4: The 'serves' field is documentation only. Slot matching is done by the engine from the real scraped title, not from this field.
